Welcome

Every girl has a voice worth hearing

At Asylkech we believe that girls learn best when they feel seen, safe and challenged. Our classrooms are places where it is normal to ask questions, to lead a project and to speak in front of others.

We combine the Kyrgyz national curriculum with a strong language programme, modern STEM learning and a culture of good manners, respect and care for one another.

Director, Asylkech Girls' School

Why Asylkech

What families value most

Ambitious learning

Small classes, attentive teachers and clear goals for every pupil, from first reading lessons to university preparation.

Languages for the world

Kyrgyz, Russian and English every week, so our girls feel at home at the table, in class and abroad.

Character and values

Respect, modesty, responsibility and kindness are taught as carefully as mathematics.

A safe, caring school

A calm girls-only environment with a class teacher, school psychologist and medical office close at hand.

Our school

One school, every stage

Grades 1–4

Primary school

Reading, writing and number skills built with patience and joy. Lots of play, art and outdoor time.

Afternoons full of discovery
